quests.name: Proof of Clan Alliance (4 level)
quests.description: One-time | Location: Giran

steps.title: 1. The starting NPC Sir Kristof Rodemai is in the Giran Warriors Guild. Talk to Sir
steps.text:
The starting NPC Sir Kristof Rodemai is in the Giran Warriors Guild. Talk to Sir Kristof to start the quest.

Only a Clan Leader of level 3 can start the quest.

2. Teleport to the Ivory Tower, then head southeast to the Forest of Evil. (Club Card holders can teleport to the location). Find Kalis Witch and talk to her.

3. Statue Of Offering is next to Kalis.

Three clan members must swear allegiance to the clan. Each character must interact with the statue to confirm their oath.

Confirming the oath may kill the character.

Each pledge will receive Symbol of Loyalty NG x 1. Give the item to your Clan Leader.

4. As the Clan Leader, collect three Symbol of Loyalty NG and talk to Kalis Witch .

Kalis will give Antidote Recipe List NG and apply a negative effect to the Clan Leader:

Poison of Death Lv. 1 — You have been infected by a fatal poison.

Sworn clan members must rescue their Clan Leader by completing the following quest items.

5.1. As a sworn character, teleport to Aden, then to the Plains of Glory. Find and kill monsters:

Vanor Silenos Shaman Lv. 49

Until you get Herb of Vanor NG

5.2. As a sworn character, teleport to Hunters Village, then to the Forest of Mirrors. Find and kill monsters:

Harit Lizardman Shaman Lv. 54

Until you get Herb of Harit NG

5.3. As a sworn character, teleport to Oren, then to Outlaw Forest. Find and kill monsters:

Oel Mahum Witch Doctor Lv. 55

Until you get Herb of Oel Mahum NG

6. With the sworn characters, teleport to Giran, then to Hardin's Academy. Head west, find Athrea Witch and talk to her.

Play BINGO with Athrea! Attack with all characters:

Box Of Athrea 1 Quest Monster Lv. 50 Box Of Athrea 2 Quest Monster Lv. 50 Box Of Athrea 3 Quest Monster Lv. 50 Box Of Athrea 4 Quest Monster Lv. 50 Box Of Athrea 5 Quest Monster Lv. 50

Until 4 Chests shout BINGO!

Talk to Athrea again, she will give you Blood of Eva NG

7. With the sworn characters, return to the Clan Leader and give him all the items you have obtained.

After receiving all the items, the Clan Leader must talk to Kalis Witch

Kalis will give:

Potion of Recovery NG Voucher of Faith NG

Use Potion of Recovery to cure Poison of Death.

8. Return to Sir Kristof Rodemai in the Warriors Guild of Giran and speak with him.

Sir Kristof Rodemai will complete the quest and give you Alliance Manifesto NG

Use the Alliance Manifesto to develop your clan to level 4.

quests.name: Pursuit of Clan Ambition! (5 level)
quests.description: One-time | Location: Oren

steps.title: 1. The starting NPC Sir Kristof Rodemai is near the Oren Warriors Guild. Talk to Si
steps.text:
The starting NPC Sir Kristof Rodemai is near the Oren Warriors Guild. Talk to Sir Gustav to start the quest.

Sir Gustav Athebaldt will give Gustav's 1st Letter NG

Only a Clan Leader of level 4 can start the quest.

2. Teleport to Giran. Find Martien at the northeastern exit and talk to him.

In the second point of the quest there is a difference between early and late stages of the server.

3. Teleport to Giran. Find Kusto Head Blacksmith in the Blacksmith Shop and talk to him.

Kusto will give Black Anvil Coin NG

4. In Giran, at the northeastern exit, find Martien and talk to him.

5. Teleport to Oren. Find Sir Gustav Athebaldt near the Warriors Guild and talk to him.

Sir Gustav Athebaldt will give Gustav's 2nd Letter NG

6. Teleport to Hunters Village. Find Balthazar near the Blacksmith Shop and talk to him.

Balthazar will give you Recipe: Titan's Powerstone NG

In the sixth point of the quest there is a difference between the early and late stages of the server.

There are no differences in the following points.

7. Teleport to Hunters Village. Find Balthazar near the Blacksmith Shop and talk to him.

8. Teleport to Oren near the Warriors Guild. Find Sir Gustav Athebaldt and talk to him.

Sir Gustav Athebaldt will give Gustav's 3rd Letter NG

9. Teleport to Aden. Find Sir Eric Rodemai in the central square and talk to him.

10. Leave Aden through the eastern gate. Follow the road towards the Cemetry. At the first fork, find Cleo Witch and talk to her.

After the conversation Kalis Witch will appear

11. Return to Sir Eric Rodemai and talk to him.

12. Teleport from Aden to The Forbidden Gateway, then head to the Cemetery. Find and kill monsters:

Grave Guard Lv. 54

Until the quest monster appears:

Grave Keymaster Quest Monster Lv. 65

Kill quest monsters until you collect Imperial Key NG x 6

13. Head to the western part of the Cemetery. Find two pits with monsters. Inside the pits, find and kill monsters Imperial Gravekeeper Quest Monster Lv. 60 , until the following appear:

Imperial Coffer Imperial Slave Quest Monster Lv. 56 x 4

Open the Emperor's Chest to receive Scepter of Judgment NG

There is no need to kill the Imperial Slave.

14. Teleport to Aden. Find Sir Eric Rodemai in the central square and talk to him.

15. Teleport to Oren. Find Sir Gustav Athebaldt near the Warriors Guild and talk to him.

Sir Gustav Athebaldt will complete the quest and give you Seal of Aspiration NG

Use the Seal of Aspiration to develop your clan to level 5.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.text:

Floran Village. Teleport to Floran from the Newbie Helper or Club Manager. Leave the village through the southern gate and run down the road to the mill. The Black Judge is standing near the mill.

Hardin's Private Academy. Teleport from Giran to Hardin's Private Academy. Turn your back to the cave entrance and run deeper into the area. On your right, you'll see a rocks between the trees — the Black Judge is standing on one of the rocks.

quests.name: Letters of Love
quests.description: Darin, a young man on Talking Island, carries a torch for Gatekeeper Roxxy, who doesn't return his affections. Darin is not so easily dissuaded, however.

steps.title: 1: Delivery of Love Letters
steps.text: Darin of Talking Island Village has fallen in love with Gatekeeper Roxxy. He is too shy to express his feelings and asks you to deliver his love letter to her.

steps.title: 2: Roxxy's Kerchief
steps.text: Roxxy reads Darin's letter and tells you that she admires him as well. She asks you to deliver her kerchief to him. Take Roxxy's kerchief to Darin in the village square.

steps.title: 3: Baulro's Magic Potion
steps.text: Darin is overjoyed to learn that Roxxy returns his admiration, and says he wants to ask her for a date. He asks you to go and get a love potion promised to him by Magister Baulro at the temple.

steps.title: 4: Water that Brings Out Courage
steps.text: Magister Baulro admits that he deceived Darin about the potion in order to bolster his courage. He gives you a medicine bottle filled with tap water. Take it to Darin in the village square.

quests.name: What Women Want
quests.description: Arujian, a young man in the Elven Village, adores Magister Greenis with all his heart, but no one knows if Greenis returns his affections.

steps.title: 1: Arujien's Letter
steps.text: Arujien confesses to you that he has pined for Magister Greenis for a long time. He asks you to find out if Greenis returns his affection. Meet with her younger sister, Gatekeeper Mirabel, and show her Arujien's letter.

steps.title: 2: Uncle Herbiel
steps.text: Gatekeeper Mirabel says that she doesn't get involved in her sister's affairs. She suggests that you ask Trader Herbiel. You will find him in a magic shop. Show him Arujien's Letter.

steps.title: 3: Uncle's Advice
steps.text: Trader Herbiel thinks that Magister Greenis likes Arujien. Go back to Arujien and give him the good news.

steps.title: 4: Feelings that Have Turned into a Poem
steps.text: Arujien says that he's written a book of poetry for Greenis. Take Arujien's poetry book to Magister Greenis.

steps.title: 5: Letter of Refusal
steps.text: Magister Greenis informs you that she loves another. Take Greenis' letter of refusal to Arujian.

quests.name: Long live the Pa'agrio Lord!
quests.description: Pa'agrio Lord Kakai, the leader of all the Orcs, is sick! The elders have decided that each tribe will need to deliver a present to him to ensure he has a speedy recovery.

steps.title: 1: Gifts from the Six Tribes
steps.text: You must meet with the following tribal representatives: Tataru Zu Hestui of the dignified Hestui tribe; Chief Varkees of the cold-blooded Atuba tribe; Warehouse Keeper Grookin of the formidable Neruga tribe; Gantaki Zu Urutu of the strong-willed Urutu tribe; Trader Kunai of the tactical Dudamara tribe; Trader Uska of the ruthless Gandi tribe.

steps.title: 2: Return to Nakusin
steps.text: You have collected all of the tributes for Pa'agrio Lord Kakai. Take them to Centurion Nakusin.

quests.name: Miner's Favor
quests.description: The guildsmen of the Gray Pillar Guild are hard at work in the Strip Mine. Miner Bolter is concerned that no one is available to gather the supplies the village needs.

steps.title: 1: Errand to the Village
steps.text: Miner Bolter, a member of the Gray Pillar Guild, lives at the Strip Mine. He asks you to bring him some things from the village. Visit Trader Shari's weapons shop, Trader Garita's store, Warehouse Chief Reed and Blacksmith Brunon and bring back the items that Miner Bolter is seeking.

steps.title: 2: Return to Miner Bolter.
steps.text: You have all of the items Bolter requested. Take them to him.

quests.name: Deliver Goods
quests.description: Cargo that was presumed lost in a recent shipwreck has been recovered. Help Guard Arnold deliver the cargo to its recipients.

steps.title: 1: Deliver Goods
steps.text: Guard Arnold, who has been working on the recovery of several recent shipwrecks, asks you to deliver some salvaged goods. Deliver the wooden box to Trader Jackson in the weapons shop. Deliver the bolts of cloth to Trader Silvia at the grocery store, and deliver the clay jar to Warehouse Keeper Rant.

steps.title: 2: Delivery Report
steps.text: You have delivered the salvaged goods. Report to Guard Arnold.

quests.name: Sacrifice to the Sea
quests.description: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell plans a ritual sacrifice to calm the storms that have been battering the island. This time he intends to use a doll instead of a live virgin.

steps.title: 1: Ritual for Shilen
steps.text: In order to calm the violent storms that have battered the island, Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell is planning a ritual sacrifice to the goddess Shilen. The original ritual calls for a live maiden, but he decides to offer a doll instead. To make the hair of the doll, he needs fox fur. Hunt keltirs around the village and take 10 units of fox fur to Cristel in the village.

steps.title: 2: Doll's Hair
steps.text: You have obtained 10 units of fox fur. Take them to Cristel.

steps.title: 3: Completed Doll
steps.text: The fox fur yarn for the doll's hair has been spun. Take it to Warehouse Keeper Rolfe.

steps.title: 4: Offerings for a Ritual
steps.text: Warehouse Keeper Rolfe has made the doll and attached its hair. Take the finished doll to Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell.

quests.name: Mass of Darkness
quests.description: The Mass of Darkness is performed in honor of Shilen, the mother of all Dark Elves. Let's all work together to make this the best festival ever!

steps.title: 1: Items Needed for the Mass of Darkness.
steps.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias is busily preparing for the ceremony of Shilen and Gran Kain. He asks you to go to the village and obtain several items that he will need for the Mass of Darkness. He asks for the following: a ceremonial dagger from Trader Iria in the Weapons Shop, dreviant wine from Warehouse Keeper Dorankus, and Garmiel's scripture from Master Trudy of the Elder Council.

steps.title: 2: Return to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias
steps.text: You've obtained the ceremonial dagger, the dreviant wine and Garmiel's scripture that are needed for the Mass. Take them to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias.

quests.name: Step into the Future
quests.description: Gatekeeper Roxxy speaks of the wonders of the world beyond Talking Island. She fills your heart with hope for adventure!

rewards.name: Scroll of Escape: Town of Giran

steps.title: 1: Helping Hand
steps.text: You've decided to experience all the adventure this world has to offer, but you can't afford it. Visit Magister Baulro and ask for help.

steps.title: 2: Permission of Archon
steps.text: Magister Baulro says that he'll help you! He gives you a letter to take to Sir Collin Windawood in the Obelisk of Victory. He says Sir Collin may do you a favor if you ask him nicely.

steps.title: 3: On to Giran!
steps.text: Recognizing your youthful vigor and ambition, Sir Collin Windawood agrees to sponsor your trip to Giran. Visit Gatekeeper Roxxy and tell her what Sir Windawood said.

quests.name: A Trip Begins
quests.description: One road is open to all who wish to see the world!

rewards.name: Scroll of Escape: Town of Giran

steps.title: 1: A Predecessor's Advice
steps.text: At one time, Trader Ariel was an Adventurer who traveled many places and had many exciting experiences before coming back to Elven Forest. Ask for her advice.

steps.title: 2: Help From the Hierarch
steps.text: It's said that Hierarch Asterios sponsors travelers because he wants young Elves to have all the experiences the outside world can offer. Visit Hierarch Asterios.

steps.title: 3: Prepare for a Trip
steps.text: After securing a promise to return, Hierarch Asterios tells you to visit Gatekeeper Mirabel when you've finished preparing for the trip.

quests.name: An Adventure Begins
quests.description: One road is open to all who wish to see the world!

rewards.name: Scroll of Escape: Town of Giran

steps.title: 1: Secret Revenge
steps.text: Gatekeeper Jasmine ignores your request and says that you're as reckless as Roselyn was when she was young. Visit Sentry Roselyn to find a solution.

steps.title: 2: Roselyn's Revenge
steps.text: Roselyn is angered by Jasmine's indelicate remark. She asks you to deliver a note containing an important story about Jasmine to Magister Harne.

steps.title: 3: Jasmine's Judgment
steps.text: Magister Harne has seen the two sisters, Roselyn and Jasmine, fighting for a long time. She asks you to return to Jasmine and deliver her message.

quests.name: Into the City of Humans
quests.description: Centurion Petukai seeks the true meaning of power. The place to go to learn about the history of your defeats is...

rewards.name: Scroll of Escape: Town of Giran

steps.title: 1: Centurion's Inquisition
steps.text: Centurion Petukai, in service to Flame Lord Kakai, questions the meaning of strength. He asks you to visit Seer Tanapi and get the answer.

steps.title: 2: To the City of Humans
steps.text: Seer Tanapi tells you to go to the city of Humans, Giran, to find answers to the questions asked by Orcs. Visit Gatekeeper Tamil.

quests.name: Into the World
quests.description: One road is open to all who wish to see the world!

rewards.name: Scroll of Escape: Town of Giran

steps.title: 1: Balanki's Test
steps.text: Silver Scale's Balanki permits a trip if the traveler passes his test. Go see Warehouse Chief Reed.

steps.title: 2: Mining Rights at the Mithril Mines
steps.text: Warehouse Chief Reed asks you to take a necklace he made to Priest of the Earth Gerald. While you are meeting with the priest, find out to whom the mining rights will be granted.

steps.title: 3: Failure to Obtain the Information
steps.text: Although you gave him the gift, Gerald did not offer you any information in detail. Return to Warehouse Chief Reed and tell him what you found out.

steps.title: 4: Bon Voyage!
steps.text: You've got the permission from Warehouse Chief Reed. Return to Silver Scale's Balanki and start your trip.

quests.name: To Talking Island
quests.description: Leave the hustle and bustle of Giran far behind and return to peaceful Talking Island!

rewards.name: Scroll of Escape: Talking Island Village

steps.title: 1: First Scroll
steps.text: You came to get help with the Traveler's Mark, but Galladucci will only help you if you work for him. Take the scroll and visit Magic Trader Gentler.

steps.title: 2: To the Luxury Shop
steps.text: Take the sword of magic that Galladucci ordered and return to the Luxury Shop.

steps.title: 3: Second Scroll
steps.text: Get a new scroll and visit Jeweler Sandra at the Jewelry Shop.

steps.title: 4: Return to the Boutique
steps.text: You've received gemstone powder from Sandra. Take it to Galladucci at his boutique.

steps.title: 5: Third Order Document
steps.text: This is the last errand for Galladucci. Visit Priest Dustin at the Einhasad Temple and deliver the scroll.

steps.title: 6: Last Delivery
steps.text: You've got the purified necklace that was once cursed. Deliver it to Galladucci at his boutique.

quests.name: Find Sir Windawood
quests.description: An important letter has arrived for Sir Colin Windawood, the Consul of Talking Island. Sir Windawood, more likely to be found out on a stroll than in his office, hasn't seen it. Find Sir Windawood and deliver the letter to him.

steps.title: 1: Find Sir Windawood
steps.text: Guard Abellos tells you that an urgent message has arrived from Gludio Castle for Sir Collin Windawood, the Consul of Talking Island. He asks you to deliver the message to the Consul near the Obelisk of Victory.

quests.name: Nerupa's Request
quests.description: Nerupa, the caretaker of the Mother Tree, is seeking a volunteer to visit the village on her behalf. The Hierarch will not permit her to go there.

steps.title: 1: Delivery of Goods
steps.text: Trader Unoren asked Nerupa to collect silvery spidersilks for him. Norupa doesn't want to enter the village and asks you to deliver the silvery spidersilks to Trader Unoren in the weapons shop and bring back a nightshade leaf.

steps.title: 2: Nightshade Leaf
steps.text: Nightshade leaves are very rare. Fortunately, Trader Creamees of the magic shop has obtained a few of them. Go see him with Unoren's receipt.

steps.title: 3: Go to the Warehouse
steps.text: Since nightshade leaf is so rare it has been stored in the warehouse. Take Creamees' ticket to Warehouse Keeper Julia.

steps.title: 4: Goods to be delivered to Nerupa.
steps.text: You've obtained the nightshade leaf that Creamees stored in the warehouse. Deliver it to Nerupa.

quests.name: Fruit of the Mother Tree
quests.description: Elves owe their long lifespans to their consumption of the fruit of the Mother Tree. The caretakers of the tree are quite concerned about the recent decline in production of fruit.

steps.title: 1: Fruit of the Mother Tree
steps.text: Andellia and her sisters care for the Mother Trees. You received a letter informing you that the Mother Tree near Iris Lake, maintained by their younger sister Thalia, has borne fruit. Since Andellia and her sisters cannot leave the Mother Trees untended, they ask you to visit Thalia and bring back the fruit of the Mother Tree.

steps.title: 2: The One and Only Fruit
steps.text: Thalia gives you the fruit of the Mother Tree that was harvested some time ago. This was the only fruit she harvested this year. She asks you to carefully take it to her sister Andellia.

quests.name: Shilen's Hunt
quests.description: The Mass of Darkness in honor of Shilen is about to begin. Prepare for the Hunt of Glory! Take your bows and arrows and find offerings for the Mother of Abyss!

steps.title: 1: Shilen's Hunt
steps.text: Shilen's Hunt will soon be held in the Dark Elf Village. Wild game will be hunted and offered as an sacrifice. The hunter who obtains dark bezoars will receive a reward given by the Abyssal Celebrants. Hunt Young Brown Keltirs, Brown Keltirs, Elder Brown Keltirs and Ashen Wolves, obtain dark bezoars and take them to Sentry Nelsya.

steps.title: 2: Best Hunter Award
steps.text: You've collected all 13 dark bezoars. Take them to Sentry Nelsya immediately and claim your prize and the honor of being this year's best hunter.

quests.name: Deliver Supplies
quests.description: Tetrarch Kaitar is known to see the future. He has forseen that the village will soon come under attack.

steps.title: 1: New Weapon
steps.text: Sentry Jenna says that according to Tetrarch Kaitar's prophecy, the Dark Forest will soon be invaded by outside forces. To prepare for the attack, all Sentries are optimizing their weapons. Master Harant has promised to provide them with new weapons, and they ask you to fetch them.

steps.title: 2: Three Swords
steps.text: Master Harant has given you three sentry blades onto which he has bestowed magic power. He asks you to deliver them to Sentry Jenna.

steps.title: 3: Delivery of a Sword
steps.text: Sentry Jenna asks you to immediately deliver the completed swords to her sisters. Deliver the swords to Sentry Roselyn and Sentry Kristin, collect the old bronze swords that they have been using and bring them back.

steps.title: 4: Worn Out Old Bronze Sword
steps.text: You have delivered all the swords. Take the bronze swords to Sentry Jenna.

quests.name: Bring Wolf Pelts
quests.description: Sir Windawood has ordered the newly-appointed Archon to form a militia to improve security on the island. He has placed a large order for leather armor from Trader Lector. Gather wolf pelts to help secure peace on Talking Island!

steps.title: 1: Wolf Pelts
steps.text: Lector asks you to collect 30 Wolf Pelts and bring them to him right away. Hunt to the Wolf and Elder Wolf.

steps.title: 2: Return to Trader Lector
steps.text: You've collected 30 Wolf Pelts. Take them to Trader Lector so he can make leather armor for the militia.

quests.name: Keen Claws
quests.description: Trader Payne has developed a unique arrow that uses a wolf claw as its arrowhead! It is most effective in siege situations. Payne is paying rewards to whoever brings him wolf claws to fill the huge order of Kiel Nighthawk.

steps.title: 1: Collect Claws
steps.text: Trader Payne ask collect and bring him 30 Wolf Claws. Hunt Ashen Wolves and Goblins.

steps.title: 2: Return to Trader Payne
steps.text: You've collected 30 wolf claws. Take them to Trader Payne so that he can make the arrows.

quests.name: Pleas of Pixies
quests.description: Many keltir and wolves have grown unusually large in the Elven Forest, and are now breaking the rules of nature by devouring nesting birds! The Pixy Queen is preparing some special magic to deal with them...

steps.title: 1: Collect Fangs
steps.text: Pixy Murika asks you to collect 40 Predator's Fang. Hunt in the Elven Forest: Young Red Keltirs, Red Keltirs, Elder Red Keltirs and Gray Wolves.

steps.title: 2: Return to Pixy Murika
steps.text: You have collected 40 fangs. Take them to Pixy Murika so that the birds in the Elven Forest can be protected.

quests.name: Wrath of Verdure
quests.description: Treant Bremec, a spirit of the forest, is being tormented by wicked little goblins who recently invaded and began logging his forest. He asks for help in restoring peace to his beloved woods.

steps.title: 1: Goblin Hunting
steps.text: Treant Bremec asks for your help. Defeat the goblins and return the clubs that they stole to Treant Bremec and you shall be rewarded. Hunt the Goblin Raider.

quests.name: Proof of Valor
quests.description: Are you a real Orc Fighter or just a wannabe? Prove yourself!

steps.title: 1: Kasha Wolf Fang
steps.text: Praetorian Rukain believes that those who wish to become Orc Fighters must prove their valor by hunting Kasha Wolves and bringing back 30 Kasha Wolf Fang .

steps.title: 2: Return to Praetorian Rukain
steps.text: You have taken 30 fangs from the kasha wolves. You have done what it takes to become a brave Orc Fighter. Return to Praetorian Rukain and receive your Proof of Valor.

quests.name: Revenge of the Redbonnet
quests.description: As a child, Maryse Redbonnet narrowly escaped being eaten by wolves. Her family was not so lucky. She has sworn revenge on all wolves!

steps.title: 1: Maryse's Anger
steps.text: Maryse Redbonnet asks that you hunt the Black Wolves around the village, gather their pelts and bring them back to her. For every 30 pelts she will give you a reward.

steps.title: 2: Maryse's Revenge
steps.text: As Maryse Redbonnet requested, you've hunted wolves and collected 30 wolf pelts. Take them to her.

quests.name: Recover Smuggled Goods
quests.description: Warehouse Keeper Wilford is breaking the trade embargo against Gracia that was imposed after the recent war. He should be careful...

steps.title: 1: Toad Hunting
steps.text: Warehouse keeper Wilfred asks you to return the lost cargo. Hunt the Giant Toads and recover the Adamantite Ore.

steps.title: 2: Return to Warehouse Keeper Wilford
steps.text: You've recovered all the adamantite ore scattered on the shore. Take it to Warehouse Keeper Wilford.

quests.name: Wrath of Ancestors
quests.description: Those impudent goblin grave robbers have insulted the ancient spirits for the last time! There's no longer any reason to put up with their insolence! Let them now taste Orcish steel!

steps.title: 1: The Terrible End of a Grave Robber
steps.text: Seer Livina asks you to kill the Goblin Grave Robbers and Goblin Tomb Raider Leaders and bring back their heads. You will find them on the Northern Immortal Plateau.

quests.name: Brigands Sweep
quests.description: Convoys of the Golden Wheel Guild have recently come under daring attacks from goblin bandits. For the sake of Maphr, this outrage must be avenged! Let's give those goblins a dose of Dwarven justice!

steps.title: 1: Goblin Hunting
steps.text: Elder Spiron asks you to purge goblins from the mountains. Hunt - Goblin Snoopers, Goblin Brigands, Goblin Brigand Lieutenants, Goblin Brigand Leaders and the Goblin Lord.

steps.title: 2: Suspicious Contract
steps.text: When you re-assemble the pieces of the memo, you see that it's a contract between the Silver Scale Guild and a bandit. Elder Spiron of the Golden Wheel Guild and Balanki of the Silver Scale Guild would both find this very interesting... Or you could continue to hunt... Hunt the goblin snoopers, goblin brigands, goblin brigand lieutenants, goblin brigand leaders and the goblin lord.

quests.name: The Guard is Busy
quests.description: Talking Island's immigration policy has been relaxed in order to give refuge to those who have fled the violence of the Gracian War. But it's still quite a dangerous place!

steps.title: 1: War with the Primitive Tribe
steps.text: Captain Gilbert asks you to eliminate the Orcs and werewolves. Hunt near the Obelisk of Victory - Orcs, Orc Archers, Orc Fighters, Orc Lieutenants, Orc Fighter Leaders, Werewolves, Werewolf Hunters and Werewolf Chieftains.

quests.name: Orc Hunting
quests.description: Kaboo Orcs from the Misty Mountains have begun invading the Elven Forest. They've even infiltrated the village under the very eyes of the guards! All brave Elves who can help are asked to report to Sentinel Rayen!

steps.title: 1: Hunt for Kaboo Orcs
steps.text: Sentinel Rayen is recruiting warriors to fight the orcs. Hunt near the Elven Village - Kaboo Orc, Kaboo Orc Archer and Kaboo Orc Grunt. Hunt in the Elven Forest - Kaboo Orc Fighter Leader, Kaboo Orc Fighter Lieutenant and Kaboo Orc Fighter.

quests.name: Bonds of Slavery
quests.description: Our former slaves, the Imps, managed to escape while we were distracted by the war. It's time we teach those ungrateful wretches that no one escapes the Dark Elves!

steps.title: 1: Imp Shackle
steps.text: Go to the Dark Elven Forest and take an imp shackle to Sentry Kristin. Hunt - Imps and Imp Elders.

quests.name: Invaders of the Holy Land
quests.description: Imps are invading the Immortal Plateau, the ancestral Orcish homeland! Those impetus and foolish imps don't stand a chance against us! In the sacred name of Pa'agrio, the Lord of Flame! Arise, Orc warriors! Drive this scourge from our land!

steps.title: 1: Rakeclaw Imp
steps.text: Atuba Chief Varkees reports that rakeclaw imps have invaded the Immortal Plateau. Hunt in the Valley of Heroes - Rakeclaw Imps and Rakeclaw Imp Hunters. On the northern Immortal Plateau, hunt - Rakeclaw Imp Chieftains.

quests.name: The Hidden Veins
quests.description: Elder Filaur, an expert in the construction and mining business, has learned that Otuk Orcs have recently discovered a long-lost chrysolite mine...

steps.title: 1: Chrysolite
steps.text: Elder Filaur asks you defeat the Utuku Orcs and bring the Chrysolite Ore they possess . Also collect the four pieces of the map that reveals the location of the vein, and take them to Maphr Priestess Chichirin who will put them together for you. Then, take the map to Elder Filaur to claim a great reward. Hunt in the Frozen Valley - Utuku Orcs, and Utuku Orc Grunts. Hunt in the Western Mining Zone - Utuku Orc Archers.

quests.name: Trade with the Ivory Tower
quests.description: Trader Vollodos reports an increased demand for special spores produced only in the Dark Elven Forest. He promises a reward to whoever brings him these special spores...

steps.title: 1: Spore Fungus
steps.text: Trader Vollodos offers you a reward if you'll bring him fungus spores. Hunt in the Dark Forest: Green Fungus and Blood Fungus.

steps.title: 2: Return to Trader Vollodos
steps.text: You have collected 10 spore sacs. Take them to Trader Vollodos in the Dark Elf Village for a reward.

quests.name: Orc Subjugation
quests.description: Our former slaves, the Balor Orcs, have dared to defy us! Now they're hiding in the mountains! Arise, warriors of Shilen, and teach our former slaves a lesson!

steps.title: 1: Hunt for Balor Orcs
steps.text: Defeat the Balor Orcs and bring proof to Sentry Kayleen for a reward. Hunt to Balor Orc Archers, Balor Orc Fighters, Balor Orc Lieutenants and Balor Orc Fighter Leaders.

quests.name: Collect Spores
quests.description: The Sea of Spores was created by an evil magic set loose in the Great War over 2000 years ago! The evil poison has endured through the millenia, and even now is crossing the mountains, making its way straight towards the Elven Forest! The Elves are frantically trying to find a way to stop it.

steps.title: 1: Research of Spores
steps.text: Herbiel asks you collect spore sacs in the Elven Forest. Monsters to be hunted: Spore Fungus.

steps.title: 2: Return to Trader Herbiel
steps.text: You've collected 10 spore sacs. Take them to Trader Herbiel of the Elven Village so that they can be used for spore research.

quests.name: Sword of Solidarity
quests.description: The Sword of Solidarity has long symbolized the friendship between Elves and Humans. The disappearance of the sword has coincided with the deterioration of that friendship. Grand Master Roien is seeking a warrior to restore the sword to its place of honor.

steps.title: 1: Broken Sword
steps.text: Grand Master Roien of Cedric's Training Hall wants to restore the sword of solidarity. He explains that the sword was made long ago to symbolize the friendship between Elves and Humans. He mentions that Blacksmith Altran is also very interested in restoring this relic. He asks you to take the letter containing the results of his investigation of the relic to Altran in the Blacksmith Shop.

steps.title: 2: Broken Sword Blade Piece
steps.text: Blacksmith Altran explains that if he is to restore the Sword of Solidarity to its original condition, he must have the two pieces of the blade. He asks you to go the Elven Ruins and obtain the broken sword blade pieces from the Orcs there. Hunt Tunath Orc Warriors and Tunath Orc Marksmen.

steps.title: 3: Return to Blacksmith Altran
steps.text: Take the broken sword blade pieces to Blacksmith Altran.

steps.title: 4: Last Parts
steps.text: While Blacksmith Altran joins the sword blade pieces together, go to Cedric's Training Hall and obtain the broken sword handle from Grand Master Roien.

steps.title: 5: Sword of Solidarity
steps.text: Take the broken sword handle to Blacksmith Altran so he can restore the sword of solidarity to its original condition.

quests.name: Skirmish with the Werewolves
quests.description: The fiendish Maraku Werewolves will pay for murdering a messenger of the Lord of Flame! In the name of Pa'agrio, kill them all!

steps.title: 1: Blood Relatives' Revenge
steps.text: Prefect Brucurs asks you to kill the Maraku Werewolves and return their heads and totems.

steps.title: 2: Return to Prefect Brukurse
steps.text: You have collected 40 Maraku werewolf heads. Take them to Prefect Brukurse.

quests.name: Spirit of Craftsman
quests.description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

steps.title: 1: Method of Refining Oriharukon Ore
steps.text: The Dark Elven Blacksmith, Karrod, wishes to conjure the spirit of Warsmith Roberto Steelbender in order to learn how to refine oriharukon ore. He asks for help in summoning the dead man's spirit. Visit Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon of the Temple of Shilen.

steps.title: 2: Net for Tying Up Dead Spirits
steps.text: Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon tells you that in order to summon Steelbender from the Well of Dead Souls he will need a soul catcher. Visit Magister Harne and ask him how to get a soul catcher.

steps.title: 3: Ingredients for Soul Catcher
steps.text: 10 old bones are needed to make a soul catcher. Go to the School of Dark Arts, kill skeletons and bring back their bone fragments. Kill skeleton hunters, archers and doom soldiers.

steps.title: 4: Return to Harne
steps.text: You have collected all 10 bone fragments. Return to Magister Harne in Dark Elf Village and have the soul catcher made.

steps.title: 5: Container to Hold Souls
steps.text: A soul catcher has been created! Take it to Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon.

steps.title: 6: Zombie's Head
steps.text: The preparations for summoning Steelbender have almost all been completed. All that remains is to obtain a zombie head to temporarily hold the spirit. Go to the Swampland, kill a zombie and bring back its head. Hunt marsh zombies.

steps.title: 7: Return to Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon.
steps.text: You have applied the preserving oil to the zombie head. Take it to Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon before it begins to rot.

steps.title: 8: Steelbender Head
steps.text: Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon has conjured the soul of Steelbender by using the soul catcher. He then channels the spirit into the zombie head. Take it to Blacksmith Karrod before it starts to rot.

quests.name: Spirit of Mirrors
quests.description: Three Spirits of Mirror have escaped from Magister Gallint's laboratory on Talking Island! Capture and seal these spirits!

steps.title: 1: Escaped Spirits
steps.text: The spirits of mirrors that Grand Magister Gallint was studying have escaped! Hit each one of them with Gallint's oak wand to seal them. Seal all three and return to Gallint. The guards in the village can tell you where to find the spirits. Monsters that need to be sealed by Gallint's Oak Wand - 3 spirits of mirrors.

steps.title: 2: Location of the Spirits
steps.text: The spirits of mirrors that Grand Magister Gallint was studying have escaped! Hit each one of them with Gallint's oak wand to seal them. Seal all three and return to Gallint. You will find one of them on the western shore of the island, another near the bridge west of Einhovant's School of Wizardry and the third can be found near the Obelisk of Victory. Monsters that need to be sealed by Gallint's Oak Wand - 3 spirits of mirrors.

steps.title: 3: Return to Grand Magister Gallint
steps.text: You have sealed all three of the spirits of mirrors with Gallint's oak wand! Return to Grand Magister Gallint.

quests.name: Skirmish with the Orcs
quests.description: Kaboo Orcs from the Misty Mountains have invaded the Elven Forest again. Help Sentinel Kendell and the Elven Fighters defeat the invaders and take the head of the Orc Captain!

steps.title: 1: Guardian of the Forest
steps.text: Orcs have recently made several attacks upon the Elven Forest. The Elves have decided to take their revenge upon the Kaboo Orcs in the Misty Mountains. Read the order from Sentinel Kendell and hunt the Orcs!

steps.title: 2: Return to Sentinel Kendell.
steps.text: You have destroyed the Kaboo Orcs! Report to Sentinel Kendell.

steps.title: 3: The Second Order
steps.text: The war has not yet been won. Kaboo Orcs are massing around Iris Lake in the southern part of the village and are preparing to launch an invasion! You must follow Sentinel Kendell's orders! Slay the Kaboo Orcs!

steps.title: 4: Return to Sentinel Kendell Again.
steps.text: You've successfully accomplished Kendell's second order! Return to Sentinel Kendell in the Elven Village and make your report to him.

quests.name: Forgotten Truth
quests.description: The infamous Orc Brigand has stolen Kaysha's Revelations! Retrieve this vital document to secure the future of all Dark Elves!

steps.title: 1: Kaysha's Revelations
steps.text: Dark Elven Tetrarch Thifiell asked Abyssal Celebrant Kartia to translate an ancient manuscript. He now asks you to retrieve the translated copy of 'Kaysha's Revelations'. You must be very discreet.

steps.title: 2: In Search of the Stolen Revelations
steps.text: You hear that 'Kaysha's Revelations' was stolen by Tumran Orcs! Kill the Tumran Orc brigands that were last seen camping near the Altar of Rites, and recover the original copy of 'Kaysha's Revelations' and a clay tablet.

steps.title: 3: Return to Abyssal Celebrant Kartia
steps.text: You have recovered the ancient scroll and clay tablet. Abyssal Celebrant Kartia is waiting for you.

steps.title: 4: Translation of the Completed Revelations
steps.text: The translation of 'Kaysha's Revelations' is complete. Tetrarch Thifiell is waiting for you.

quests.name: Merciless Punishment
quests.description: The exiled traitor Varangka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

steps.title: 1: Stop Varangka's Conspiracy!
steps.text: Varangka, Shaman of Darkness, is scheming to destroy the kingdom of the Orcs. Urutu Chief Hatos has learned of his plot, and has ordered the elimination of all of Varangka's followers. Kill them all! Centurion Parugon will tell you where to find them.

steps.title: 2: Catch Varangka's Messenger!
steps.text: Varangka's messengers and escorts are advancing from the far eastern Immortal Plateau to the Raider's Crossroads! Kill them all!

steps.title: 3: Discovery of the secret letter!
steps.text: You have recovered a secret letter from Varangka's messenger. Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.

steps.title: 4: Are there more secret letters?
steps.text: Varangka must have sent more than one secret letter! Find Varangka's messengers and try to find other secret letters! Monsters to Hunt - Varangka's messengers.

steps.title: 5: A second secret letter discovered!
steps.text: You've found another secret letter! Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.

steps.title: 6: Further intrigues!
steps.text: This can't be the end! Search harder! Monsters to Hunt - Varangka's messengers.

steps.title: 7: Discovery of the third secret letter!
steps.text: You've found another secret letter! Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.

quests.name: Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss
quests.description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

steps.title: 1: In Search of a Star Diamond!
steps.text: Collector Gouph of the Bronze Key Guild has purchased a rare star diamond from Trader Reep of the Silver Scales Guild. It is one of only twelve on the continent! Three days have past since the agreed-upon delivery date and Gouph is becoming impatient. He asks you to go to Trader Reep, retrieve the star diamond and bring it to him.

steps.title: 2: Carrier Torocco
steps.text: Trader Reep informs you that he gave the star diamond to Carrier Torocco to deliver to Gouph. Find Torocco and ask him about the diamond.

steps.title: 3: Booze can make you lose!
steps.text: Torocco got drunk with Miner Maron last night and passed out. When he awoke, his weapons, armor, money and even the star diamond had been stolen! Find Maron and ask him what happened.

steps.title: 4: Gambling can make you a loser, too!
steps.text: Carrier Torocco is usually quite trustworthy, but.when he starts drinking he inevitably starts gambling. He got drunk last night and lost everything he had in a dice game with Blacksmith Brunon. Could this mean that Blacksmith Brunon has the star diamond?

steps.title: 5: Brunon's Request
steps.text: Indeed, Blacksmith Brunon won the star diamond in a dice game! He tells you that he will give it to you if you recover the aquamarine and chrysoberyl that were stolen by a goblin brigand lieutenant.

steps.title: 6: Return to Blacksmith Brunon
steps.text: You have recovered the aquamarines and chrysoberyls that Blacksmith Brunon lost. Take them to him.

steps.title: 7: Gem Box
steps.text: Brunon gives you the gem box he says he won in a dice game. Take it to Gouph.

steps.title: 8: Useless Coal
steps.text: The gem box doesn't contain the star diamond, only a strange looking piece of coal! Return to Blacksmith Brunon and demand an explanation!

steps.title: 9: A Chest of Mistaken Identity
steps.text: The piece of coal once belonged to Warehouse Freightman Murdoc. Take the letter from Brunon to Murdoc and exchange it for the gem box that contains the star diamond.

steps.title: 10: The Diamond Is Gone!
steps.text: The star diamond was eaten by a bat that Warehouse Keeper Airy keeps as a pet! The bat escaped out of an open window! Go quickly and speak with Airy!

steps.title: 11: Who keeps a bat as a pet, anyway?
steps.text: Warehouse Keeper Airy asks you to find her pet, a blade bat. Kill the bat and get the diamond.

steps.title: 12: Small Sacrifice, Great Reward
steps.text: You finally recover the star diamond. Pray for the soul of the poor bat then take the star diamond to Collector Gouph.

quests.name: Shards of Golem
quests.description: The roof of Einhasad Temple has collapsed! Help Magister Harrys restore the temple!

steps.title: 1: New Tools
steps.text: A few days ago the roof of the temple was wrecked by a storm. Magister Harrys has asked Blacksmith Altran for tools with which to repair the roof. He asks you to pick up the tools from Blacksmith Altran.

steps.title: 2: Stone Hammer
steps.text: Blacksmith Altran asks you to obtain Golem Shards for him so he can make a new hammer. Hunt in the Talking Island, North - Stone Golems.

steps.title: 3: Return to Blacksmith Altran
steps.text: You have obtained 50 Golem Shards. Take them to Blacksmith Altran and ask him to make a hammer for you.

steps.title: 4: Delivery of a Tool Box
steps.text: Blacksmith Altran asks you to deliver the hammer and a tool box containing other tools to Magister Harrys.

quests.name: Covert Business
quests.description: The Bronze Key Guild has dealt in rare ingredients for millenia. They're looking for someone to hunt bats for an important client.

steps.title: 1: Hardin's Request
steps.text: Elder Keef asked to hunt bats and bring back their fangs. Hunt to the Western Mining Zone: Blade Bats and Barbed Bats.

steps.title: 2: Return to Bronze Key's Keef
steps.text: You've collected 100 bat fangs. Hurry and take them to Elder Keef of the Bronze Key Guild before anyone sees you.

quests.name: Collect Arrowheads
quests.description: Minia is a collector of odd weapons from diverse cultures. She's recently begun collecting the weaponry of Turak Orcs, native to Talking Island...

steps.title: 1: Tunath Orcs' Bow
steps.text: Master Minia of the Fighters Guild is a collector of odd weapons. She has recently become interested in the weaponry of the Tunath Orc Marksmen, and asks you to retrieve their arrowheads in the Elven Ruins.

steps.title: 2: Return to Master Minia
steps.text: You've collected 40 arrowheads from Tunath Orc marksmen. Take them to Master Minia of the Fighters Guild in Talking Island Village.

quests.name: Bones Tell the Future
quests.description: Tetrarch Kaitar predicts the future with dead men's bones. He foresees an approaching darkness that threatens to destroy all the races! He needs a secret ingredient containing awesome death energy to fully understand the prophecy...

steps.title: 1: Dead Men's Bones
steps.text: Tetrarch Kaitar needs more bone fragments of the undead and asks you to go and collect them for him. You can obtain them by going to the School of Dark Arts and hunting Skeletons.

steps.title: 2: Return to Tetrarch Kaitar
steps.text: You have collected 10 bone fragments from the undead skeletons. Take them to Tetrarch Kaitar and claim your reward.

quests.name: Legacy of the Poet
quests.description: Rumiel Moonshine, an amazing poet, entertains his companions with dark poetry, detailing the dread and sorrow of war. Alas, he succumbed too young to the violence he so eloquently described... But his soul lives on in his writings, hidden amongst the ruins of the Underground Fortress!

steps.title: 1: Legacy of a Friend
steps.text: Starden asks you to find his old friend's works somewhere in the Underground Fortress. Hunt Baraq Orc Fighters and Baraq Orc Warrior Leaders.

steps.title: 2: Return to Sentinel Starden
steps.text: You've recovered all four poems written by Rumiel the poet. Take them to Sentinel Starden.

quests.name: Dark Winged Spies
quests.description: The time has come for the traitor Varangka to pay for his crimes. Destroy the darkwing bats who spy on the tribes of the kingdom.

steps.title: 1: Varangka's Messenger
steps.text: Neruga Chief Tantus has asked that you bring back fangs of bats. Hunt in the Northern Immortal Plateau - Darkwing Bats and Varangka's Trackers.

steps.title: 2: Return to Neruga Chief Tantus
steps.text: You've collected darkwing bat fangs that can be used to stop Varangka's influence. Take them to Neruga Chief Tantus and set up a magic force field that will block Varangka's spell.

quests.name: Dreaming of the Skies
quests.description: Arin of the Black Anvil Guild has long dreamed of flying, and is now studying the ancient technology of the Titans in pursuit of his goal... But he must first find a monster with a floating stone...

steps.title: 1: Collect Floating Stones
steps.text: Elder Arin asks you hunt to spiders and collect floating stones and bring them to him. Hunt to the Western Mining Zone: Magical Weavers.

steps.title: 2: Return to Arin
steps.text: You have collected floating stones. Take them to Elder Arin of the Black Anvil Guild in Dwarven Village to claim your reward.

quests.name: Scent of Death
quests.description: A bit of ground-up corpse skin is essential for growing nightshade...

steps.title: 1: Special Fertilizer
steps.text: Trader Minaless asks you to go to the Marshlands south of the Dark Forest, slay the Marsh Zombies and bring back zombie skins.

steps.title: 2: Return to Trader Minaless
steps.text: You've obtained zombie skins as requested. Deliver them to Trader Minaless in Dark Elf Village.

quests.name: Sea of Spores Fever
quests.description: Sentinels who were conducting experiments in the Sea of Spores have all come down with a bad fever. Sentinel Knight Alberius is seeking someone to visit Master Cobendell to obtain the cure.

steps.title: 1: Cure for Fever
steps.text: Sentinel Knight Alberius tells you that the Elven researchers who have recently gone to the Sea of Spores have come down with a fever. He is concerned about the guards he has dispatched there and asks for your help. He tells you that Master Cobendell has the cure for the fever but needs the ingredients to make the antidote. Go to Master Cobendell and help him to collect the ingredients he needs.

steps.title: 2: Dryad's Tears
steps.text: You must collect dryad's tears to make the cure for the fever. Collect 10 dryad's tears in the Elven Forest and take them to Master Cobendell. Hunt dryads and dryad elders.

steps.title: 3: Return to Cobendell
steps.text: You have collected all the necessary Dryad tears. Take them to Master Cobendell in the Elven Village.

steps.title: 4: Medicine Created
steps.text: The medicine for the fever has been created! Take it to Sentinel Knight Alberius.

steps.title: 5: Delivery of Medicine
steps.text: Sentinel Knight Alberius asks you to deliver the fever medicine to four sentinels who have gone to the Sea of Spores. Take the medicine to Sentinel Berros, Sentinel Veltress, Sentinel Rayen and Sentinel Gartrandell.

steps.title: 6: Return to Sentinel Knight Alberius
steps.text: You have distributed the fever medicine. Report back to Sentinel Knight Alberius.

quests.name: Protect the Water Source
quests.description: Someone has intentionally poisoned the water supply of Elven Village! Hierarch Asterios is seeking a young volunteer to find and destroy this evil-doer to save the Mother Tree!

steps.title: 1: In Search of the Source of Pollution
steps.text: Elven Hierarch Asterios is concerned that the Mother Tree of the village is being contaminated. He asks you to visit its water source, the lake north of the village. Destroy the cause of the contamination, the plague zombies.

steps.title: 2: Suspicious Corpse
steps.text: You've obtained plague dust from a suspicious looking zombie. Could this be what Hierarch Asterios was talking about? Take it to him.

steps.title: 3: Ingredients for Purification Magic
steps.text: The dust from the zombie's flesh has been the cause of the contamination. A large amount of the dust is needed to perform a purification ritual. Hunt the Plague Zombies.

steps.title: 4: Return to Hierarch Asterios
steps.text: You've obtained enough plague dust for the purification ritual. Deliver it to Hierarch Asterios.

quests.name: Curse of the Underground Fortress
quests.description: Ancient spirits have begun haunting the ruins of the Dark Elven war in the Elven Fortress. They cry out for revenge...

steps.title: 1: The Way to Undo a Curse
steps.text: Trader Unoren asks that you bring him bone fragments of undead monsters and skulls of Elves. Hunt in the Elven Fortress: Dungeon Skeleton Soldiers, Dungeon Skeleton Archers, Dread Soldiers, Shade Horror, Dark Terrors and Mist Terrors.

steps.title: 2: Return to Trader Unoren
steps.text: You've collected all the skulls and bone pieces needed to break the curse. Return to the Elven Village and give them to Trader Unoren.

quests.name: Go Get the Calculator
quests.description: Isn't it said that insanity always lies at the heart of genius? Blacksmith Brunon dreams of being first to visit the moon, but must have something first...

steps.title: 1: To the Trade Guild
steps.text: You must travel to the Dwarven Village to obtain a newly developed calculator for the blacksmith Brunon, who has promised a considerable reward. The Trade Guild will have information regarding the device.

steps.title: 2: Where is the Female Dwarf?
steps.text: You learn that the calculator is in the possession of a female Dwarf, somewhere in the Dwarven Village. Go look for more information.

steps.title: 3: He is closer to you than you think perhaps?
steps.text: Clues suggest that the device is closer than you think. Keep looking for more information.

steps.title: 4: I've got it!
steps.text: Hmm... A female dwarf in Dwarven Village is in possession of the calculator and the person is closer than I think? I've got it! I know the answer!

steps.title: 5: Silvera's Request
steps.text: Blacksmith Silvera will give you the calculator in exchange for 10 gemstone beasts.

steps.title: 6: New Model Calculator
steps.text: Take the calculator to blacksmith Brunon.

quests.name: Cure for Fever Disease
quests.description: The students of Einhovant's School of Magic have come down with a mysterious fever. Their teacher, Elias, is quite concerned.

steps.title: 1: Spider's Poison Sac
steps.text: Priest Yohanes needs the poison sacs of many spiders, and you are asked to bring them to him. The Poison Sacs is very rare! Hunt to - Blade Spider, Giant Spider, Talon Spider.

steps.title: 2: Creation of the Cure for the Fever
steps.text: You have obtained the poison sacs of giant spiders. Take them immediately to Priest Yohanes and ask him to make the medicine!

steps.title: 3: Treatment of the Fever
steps.text: Priest Yohanes made fever medicine with the poison sacs you collected for him. Take the medicine for the students of the School of Wizardry to Master Elias immediately!

quests.name: Millennium Love
quests.description: The ramifications of the ancient battle with the devil, Beleth, still linger in this land. Lilith still grieves for her lost lover, Theon, at Einhasad Temple. His body wasn't recovered, so she's never truly accepted his death. She's waited for him for 1000 years at their agreed-upon meeting place on Talking Island...

steps.title: 1: Whereabouts of the Lost Lover
steps.text: Lilith has pined for her lost love for over a thousand years in the temple of Talking Island. She lost her lover, Theon, in the war against Beleth. Because his body was never recovered, she has never accepted his death. She asks you to look for him on your way to Gludio.

steps.title: 2: Lover's Diary
steps.text: Master Baenedes bears a remarkable resemblance to Theon. He was one of his best students, and learned to use both the sword and bow from him. Sadly, Theon passed away to be with Eva several years ago. Baenedes asks you to deliver Theon's diary to Lilith.

quests.name: Dwarven Kinship
quests.description: Warehouse Keeper Carlon hasn't seen his family since he was captured by Dark Elves ten years ago. He seeks someone to deliver a message to his brother Haprock in the Town of Gludio.

steps.title: 1: Letter of Greetings?
steps.text: The Dwarven Warehouse Freightman Carlon misses his friends and asks you to deliver a letter to Warehouse Keeper Haprock in the Town of Gludio.

steps.title: 2: Letter of Greetings? Really?
steps.text: Haprock thanks you for delivering the letter to him. He asks you to deliver a letter to Warehouse Keeper Norman in Gludin Village. The letter is supposed to be from Norman's wife, longing for him in his hometown... Do you believe him...?

quests.name: Offspring of Nightmares
quests.description: Magister Vlasty is researching the ancient monster known as the dark horror.

steps.title: 1: True Nature of Dark Horrors
steps.text: Magister Vlasty asks you to hunt Dark Horrors and bring the skulls back to him. Dark Horrors are found in the swamps southwest of the village. Even broken skulls will fetch you some adena.

steps.title: 2: Return to Magister Vlasty
steps.text: You have obtained intact skulls of dark horrors. Take them to Magister Vlasty for a reward. He also pays for broken skulls, but not as much.

quests.name: Rancher's Plea
quests.description: Edmond and Marius dream of building a successful ranch on Talking Island, but certain eight-legged monsters stand in their way...

steps.title: 1: Establish a Ranch!
steps.text: Edmond and his friend Marius offering rewards to hunters based on the number of Spider's Skins that they bring back. Hunt - Giant Spiders, Blade Spiders and Talon Spiders.

quests.name: Collector's Dream
quests.description: Alshupes, an amateur zoologist, has a particular interest in the skins and claws of rare animals. He pays a reward to whoever brings him the legs of the giant mutant spiders that lurk near the village.

steps.title: 1: Collect Spider Legs
steps.text: Alshupes is interested in giant spiders. He asks you to bring him legs of Crimson Spiders, Hook Spiders or Pincer Spiders.

steps.title: 2: Return to Alshupes
steps.text: You have collected legs of giant spiders. Take them to Alshupes to receive your reward.

quests.name: Traces of Evil
quests.description: Many creatures near the Orc Village are being contaminated and dying because of Kasha, the evil spirit of decay and death. This also includes the animals that are sacred to the tribes of Orc Village, and it is causing great distress among the Orc tribes. Trade Kunai of the Duda-Mara Orc tribe intends to use the tribe's secret in order to resolve this matter. However, it requires a medium substance, and he is searching for an adventurer to obtain it.

steps.title: 1: Hunting Kasha Spiders
steps.text: Orc Trader Kunai of the Duda-Mara tribe asks you to obtain some Kasha Spider's Rotten Secretion to use in investigating the cause. Monsters to be hunted: Kasha Spider, Kasha Fang Spider, Kasha Blader Spider.

quests.name: Totem of the Hestui
quests.description: The gray bear totem, longtime guardian of the Hestui Tribe, is under attack from the forces of the evil spirit Kasha! Save the gray bear totem from its grisly fate!

steps.title: 1: Purification of the Grizzlies
steps.text: Seer Tanapi asks you to kill the possessed gray bears and put their souls to rest. Hunt in the Northern Immortal Plateau: Kasha Bears and Kasha Bear Totem Spirits.

steps.title: 2: Return to Seer Tanapi
steps.text: You've obtained the crystals of the Kasha bear totem spirits! Take them to Seer Tanapi.

quests.name: Tarantula's Spider Silk
quests.description: The Silver Scale Guild has received a special order for 20 spider silk outfits from the King of Elmore! They are for the emissaries to Aden and must be of the highest quality! Mion, a tailor at the guild, is frantic... He's short of both time and materials!

steps.title: 1: Material for Formal Wear
steps.text: Trader Mion asks you to collect tarantula spider silk. Kill the tarantulas and bring back their silk for a reward. Monsters to Hunt - Hunter Tarantulas and Plunder Tarantulas.

quests.name: Grim Collector
quests.description: Legend says that there is someone who collects bits and pieces of undead things... What could he be thinking?

steps.title: 1: Collecting Corpses
steps.text: While discussing the ruins, Guard Curtis speaks of some good work and tells you about Samed. Visit Samed and talk about Curtis. You'll be asked to run an errand.

quests.name: Will the Seal be Broken?
quests.description: The Human has betrayed the secret that's kept Hierarch Mitraell sealed for centuries! Help Tettrarch Talloth break the seal that binds Mitraell!

steps.title: 1: Preparation for a Ritual
steps.text: Dark Elven Tetrarch Talloth is continuing in the studies of the dark arts in order to break the seal that binds Mitraell, the leader of the Dark Elves. He asks that you to go to the school of the Dark Arts and bring him an Omen Beast's eye, a Taint Stone and Succubus Blood which are all needed to break the Seal. This being the first stage among three stages that binds the great leader. Monsters to be hunted - Omen Beast, Tainted Zombies, Stink Zombies, Lesser Succubi, Lesser Succubus Turen and Lesser Succubus Tilfos

steps.title: 2: Return to Tetrarch Talloth
steps.text: You have collected all the ingredients required for a spell. Return to Hierarch Talloth.

quests.name: Crystals of Fire and Ice
quests.description: Hidden deep within the Elven Ruins are rare relics, once used in rituals honoring the ancient spirits of water and fire!... Destroy the evil that guards them and retrieve the priceless relics!

steps.title: 1: Soulstone Fragment
steps.text: Trader Katerina asks you to go to the Elven Ruins and collect flame and ice shards. Hunt in the Elven Ruins - Salamanders, Salamander Elders, Salamander Nobles, Undines, Undine Elders and Undine Nobles.

quests.name: Subjugation of Lizardmen
quests.description: Whilst beset from all directions, yet another force has begun threatening Gludio! Lizardmen have begun looting and pillaging throughout the land! Destroy them and restore the peace!

steps.title: 1: Subjugation of Felim Lizardmen
steps.text: Guard Weisz's orders state that you must recover the cargo that belongs to the Aden trade union from the Felim Lizardmen in the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds. Hunt: Felim Lizardman, Felim Lizardman Scout and Felim Lizardman Warrior.

quests.name: Destroy Plague Carriers
quests.description: The Elves have never forgiven the ratmen for introducing plague into their sacred Elven Forest... Not to mention their unholy alliance with the Dark Elves that resulted in the deaths of thousands of Elves! Master Ellenia is recruiting volunteers to destroy the filthy beasts...

steps.title: 1: Plague Carriers
steps.text: Master Ellenia asks you to kill the ratmen that are nesting in the Elven Underground Fortress. Hunt: Sukar Wererats, Sukar Wererat Leaders and Varool Foulclaw.

quests.name: Catch the Wind
quests.description: Lireins are wind spirits, and can quickly stir up quite a storm! Within their bodies you'll find soulstone wind shards, good for a variety of purposes!

steps.title: 1: The Spirit of the Storm
steps.text: Rizraell asks you to defeat the lireins and return the wind shards. You will find Lireins near the Neutral Zone towards the end of the Elven Forest.

quests.name: Sweetest Venom
quests.description: Dark Elves are very fond of drevient wine, a drink made from the venom of spiders. Astaron, a master brewer, offers to make some for you if you'll bring him the ingredients he needs.

steps.title: 1: Dreviant Wine

steps.title: 2: Return to Astaron
steps.text: You've collected spider venom sacs. Take them to Astaron so he can make dreviant wine.

quests.description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

steps.title: 1: Wipe out the Raiders!
steps.text: The guards of Giran have asked you to destroy the lizardmen that are disturbing the peace. Monsters to Hunt - Langk Lizardman Sentinel, Langk Lizardman Scout, Langk Lizardman Lieutenant, Langk Lizardman Warrior

steps.title: 2: Return to Guard Luis
steps.text: You've defeated the Langk Lizardmen that have been threatening the southern coast road. Return to Guard Luis of Gludin Village.

steps.title: 3: Mysterious Tooth
steps.text: You discover a strange tooth among the warriors' effects. Ask Magister Iris about it.

steps.title: 4: Towards Magister Rohmer
steps.text: Magister Iris was able to identify the tooth as coming from a dragon, but is unable to control it. She suggests that you ask Magister Rohmer in the Town of Gludio.

steps.title: 5: Exposed Secret
steps.text: An expert in the sorcery of Lizardmen, Magister Rohmer has important reference data and asks you to deliver it to Magister Iris at once.

steps.title: 6: Find the Tooth
steps.text: Magister Iris asks you to steal 50 teeth from the Lizardmen. Monsters to be hunted - Langk Lizardman Shaman, Langk Lizardman Leader.

steps.title: 7: Duty Fulfilled
steps.text: You've collected the 50 dragon's teeth that Magister Iris asked for. Take them to her.

quests.name: To Lead and Be Led
quests.description: Blacksmith Pinter of the Town of Gludio makes armor that only members of the Clan Academy can wear.

steps.title: 1: Slay the Maille Lizardman
steps.text: Blacksmith Pinter of the Town of Gludio tells you to bring him the materials necessary to make Clan Academy armor. Get 10 botttles of Maille Lizardman Blood. Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardman, Maille Lizardman Scout, Maille Lizardman Guard

steps.title: 2: Go to Pinter
steps.text: You have collected all the Lizardmen's blood needed. Return to Blacksmith Pinter.

steps.title: 3: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.text: Blacksmith Pinter tells you he needs 922 D-Grade crystals to make heavy armor. Your Sponsor must acquire the necessary crystals and take them to Pinter.

steps.title: 4: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.text: Blacksmith Pinter tells you he needs 771 D-Grade crystals to make light armor. Your Sponsor must acquire the necessary crystals and take them to Pinter.

steps.title: 5: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.text: Blacksmith Pinter tells you he needs 771 D-Grade crystals to make the robe. Your Sponsor must acquire the necessary crystals and take them to Pinter.

steps.title: 6: Go to Pinter
steps.text: Your Sponsor gave Blacksmith Pinter the crystals necessary for making the armor. Blacksmith Pinter has a message for you. Go to Pinter.

steps.title: 7: Defeat the King of the Araneid
steps.text: Blacksmith Pinter finally tells you to defeat the King of the Araneid in the Maille Lizardmen Barracks and collect 8 legs. You must defeat the King of the Araneid while your Sponsor is watching. Monster to Hunt - The King of the Araneid

steps.title: 8: Go to Pinter
steps.text: You've collected all the King of the Araneid's legs. Return to Blacksmith Pinter.

quests.description: The red eyes of the Maille Lizardmen behold the dark shadows cast by war-ravaged Gludio Castle.

steps.title: 1: Invaders of Gludio
steps.text: Guard Babenco of the Town of Gludio has recently noticed increased movements of Lizardmen on the west side of town and he's seeking recruits to help defeat them. All volunteers should report to Captain Bathis

steps.title: 2: Destroy the Maille Lizardmen's Vanguard
steps.text: Captain Bathis orders you to destroy the Maille Lizardmen's vanguard and bring 100 Red Bone Necklaces and 100 Black Bone Necklaces as the evidence. Monsters to be hunted - Maille Lizardman, Maille Lizardman Scout, Maille Lizardman Guard

steps.title: 3: Drumbeats of Victory
steps.text: You've destroyed the Maille Lizardmen. Take your trophies to Captain Bathis.

steps.title: 4: Search for Clues
steps.text: Captain Bathis has asked you to investigate the possibility of a relationship between Maille Lizardmen and Arachnids. Monsters to be hunted - Maille Lizardman Guards, Maille Lizardman Scouts and Giant Arachnids.

steps.title: 5: Conspiracy Revealed
steps.text: After much searching, you've discovered the clues to the conspiracy! Return to Captain Bathis.

quests.name: Seed of Evil
quests.description: Evil has spawned in the long-abandoned Elven Ruins! High Priest Biotin was warned of this menace in a dream and is gathering forces to fight the evil.

steps.title: 1: Evil Power
steps.text: High Priest Biotin had a premonition from his dreams that something wicked is growing within the Elven Ruins. He says that the evil seed looks like a gigantic bat-winged demon. He asks you to destroy it.

steps.title: 2: Return to High Priest Biotin
steps.text: You have slain Nerkas, the evil seed, and obtained the clay tablet. Take it to High Priest Biotin at the temple in the village.

quests.name: Blood Fiend
quests.description: Bloody Lord Kirunak, the leader of the dark ones, killed many brave Elven warriors at the final battle of the Underground Fortress! Legend says that he still lurks near that ruined battlefield! Arise, Elven warriors! Revenge is ours at last!

steps.title: 1: Creamees' Revenge
steps.text: Trader Creamees' friends and family were all killed by the dark side. Kirunak, the leader of the dark side, still lurks within the Underground Fortress. Creamees asks you to seek revenge upon Kirunak.

steps.title: 2: Who summoned Kirunak?
steps.text: With his dying breath, Kirunak tells you that his contract with Trader Creamees has been fulfilled. Wasn't it a Dark Elf who originally summoned Kirunak? Return to Creamees and find out what happened.

quests.name: Dangerous Seduction
quests.description: The dreams of Tetrarch Vellior are constantly haunted by a mysterious, beautiful woman! Discover the truth of her origin in the ruins of the School of Dark Arts!

steps.title: 1: Chasing a Dream-Catching Succubus
steps.text: Dark Elven Tetrarch Vellior cannot sleep because of terrible nightmares caused by a succubus. You're asked to kill the Merkenis at the School of Dark Arts.

steps.title: 2: Nightmare Crystal
steps.text: Merkenis's dying words were about Lich King Icarus. Who is he? What was the source of Tetrarch Vellior's torment? Take the nightmare crystal to the Tetrarch and make a report.

quests.name: Vanquish Remnants
quests.description: The Black Lion Mercenaries are seeking volunteers to help rid the kingdom of the last of the filthy Gracian invaders! After their humiliating defeat, most of the Gracians returned home, but a few stragglers stayed behind to loot and pillage. Stand with the Black Lion against the filthy invaders!

steps.title: 1: War with the Ol Mahums
steps.text: The Black Lion Mercenaries are recruiting skilled fighters to join their battle against the ol mahums. Hunt in the Abandoned Camp - Ol Mahum Patrols, Ol Mahum Guards, Ol Mahum Stragglers, Ol Mahum Shooters, Ol Mahum Captains, Ol Mahum Recruits, Ol Mahum Suppliers, and Ol Mahum Generals.

quests.name: Sense for Business
quests.description: Legends speak of a hidden treasure in the Wastelands... How could such a desolate place hold treasure?

steps.title: 1: Find the Magical Ingredients
steps.text: Trader Sarien asks you to retrieve a monster eye carcass and a basilisk's gizzard. Hunt in the Wastelands - Lesser Basilisk, Basilisk, Monster Eye Destroyer, Hungry Eye, Wandering Eye, Monster Eye Watcher.

quests.name: Making the Harvest Grounds Safe
quests.description: Secure the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds so the masons can work safely.

steps.title: 1: Make the Grounds Safe
steps.text: Warehouse Keeper Norman asks for your help in clearing the plantations of monsters. Hunt in the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds - Giant Poison Bee, Cloudy Beast, Young Araneid.

steps.text:
Talk to Lundy Pet Manager , who lives in Gludio.

3. Exit Gludio through the eastern gate and kill the monsters.

Maille Lizardman Lv. 22 Maille Lizardman Scout Lv. 23 Maille Lizardman Guard Lv. 24

For each monster you kill, you will receive Broken Gemstone Fragment NG . Collect 30 gems and return to Lundy.

6. Lundy thanks for the help and gives as a reward for completing the task Pet Exchange Ticket: Kookaburra NG .

quests.description: One-time | Location: Dion

3.1. Leave Dion through the east gate and find the monsters Monster Eye Gazer Lv. 25 .

For each monster you kill you will receive Map Piece NG . Collect 30 pieces and return to Waters.

For each monster you kill you will receive Map Piece NG . Collect 30 pieces and return to Waters.

6. Waters thanks for the help and gives as a reward for completing the task Pet Exchange Ticket: Buffalo NG .

You can exchange the coupon for a buffalo at any Pet Manager by selecting the line "Use Pet Exchange Coupon"

quests.name: Lizardmen's Conspiracy
quests.description: The Maille Lizardmen slowly and menacingly approach the castle. Their secret power will soon be revealed.

steps.title: 1: The Guard's Report
steps.text: Magister Rohmer of the Town of Gludio has been observing the activities of the Maille Lizardmen on the west side of town. Guard Praga asks you to deliver the data and reports his men have collected to Magister Rohmer.

steps.title: 2: Search for Beads
steps.text: Master Romer asks to hunt Maille lizardmen and spiders to get beads. Monsters to Hunt: Maille Lizardman Warriors, Maille Lizardman Shamans, Maille Lizardman Matriarchs, Poison Arachnids and King Arachnids.

steps.title: 3: Collection Complete
steps.text: You've discovered clues to the conspiracy between the Maille Lizardmen and the arachnids. Return to Magister Rohmer.

quests.name: Recover the Farmland
quests.description: All that awaited the farmers returning home from the long war was burned land and evil barbarians!

steps.title: 1: Turek Orc Hunting
steps.text: Turek Orcs have infested the previously fertile farmland northwest of Gludio. On behalf of the farmers of Gludio, Farmer Piotur is recruiting mercenaries to drive out the Orcs from their stolen farmland. Slay the Turek Orcs, collect the proofs and take them to Piotur. He will give you a reward.

steps.title: 2: Piotur's Mercenary
steps.text: Kill all the Turek Orcs and take proof to the farmer Piotur. He will give you a reward.

steps.title: 3: Turek Orc Hunting
steps.text: Slay the Turek Orcs, collect the proofs and take them to Farmer Piotur. He will give you a reward.

steps.title: 4: Relics of the Old Empire
steps.text: Guard Leiken explains that Magic Trader Asha, Trader Nestle and Magister Iris of Einhasad Temple are all quite knowledgeable about relics of the old empire.

steps.title: 5: Expert of Relics
steps.text: According to Leiken, the only people in Gludin Village interested in imperial relics are Magic Trader Asha, Magister Iris of Einhasad Temple, and Trader Nestle in the grocery store.

quests.name: Hunt of the Black Lion
quests.description: Evil spirits have taken advantage of Aden's weakness after the Gracian War to wreak havoc all over the kingdom. The Lords from each territory have called upon the Black Lion Mercenaries to drive the evil spirits away...

steps.title: 1: War Mission
steps.text: Sophya, the captain of the Black Lion Mercenaries, asks that you help to rid the Town of Dion of monsters. Eliminate the undead on the Execution Grounds, the Ol Mahums in the Fortress of Resistance, the Delu Lizardmen on the southern shores and the Marsh Stakato in the Cruma Marshlands.

quests.name: Collector of Jewels
quests.description: Magister Nell wants to know the connection between the soul stone found at the Elven Ruins on Talking Island and the one found at the Forgotten Temple... And that's not her only question!

steps.title: 1: Jewel Collection
steps.text: Magister Nell asks you to bring her back flame shards and ice shards. Hunt to the Forgotten Temple: Roxides, Lakin Undines, Rowin Undines, Death Fires, Lakin Salamanders and Salamander Rowins.

steps.title: 2: Return to Nell
steps.text: You have collected ice and flame shards. Take them to Magister Nell in Gludin Village.

quests.description: One-time | Location: Giran
