2. Buy a dagger from the arms dealer (a normal one, not a common!) and return to Cooper. Cooper thanks you for the dagger and tells you a story about his sister, a traveler. He worries that she will encounter dangerous monsters and asks you to clear the path from Dion to Giran.

3. Teleport to Dion and go to the Execution Grounds 3rd level. Kill monsters

Specter Lv. 26 Sorrow Maiden Lv. 27

For killing each monster you will receive Map Piece NG . Collect 30 pieces and return to Cooper.

4. Cooper thanks you for your help and asks you to take Ivory Colored Map NG to the Luxury Shop to the weapons dealer Galladucci Weapon Merchant .

5. Head to Luxor. Galladucci is very happy with the map and asks you to tell Cooper to come back later to get the payment.

6. Cooper thanks for the help and gives as a reward for completing the task Pet Exchange Ticket: Cougar NG .

You can exchange the coupon for a cougar at any Pet Manager by selecting the line "Use Pet Exchange Coupon".

quests.name: Acts of Evil
quests.description: Menacing evil spirits increasingly threaten the peace of Gludio! Unmask and destroy the conspiracy between the Turek Orcs and the ol mahums in the nothern part of the territory!

steps.title: 1: Stolen Cargo
steps.text: A cargo wagon transporting goods to the Dark Forest was ambushed by Turek Orcs. Guard Alvah requests that you recover the stolen cargo. You should first speak with Trader Arodin at the weapons shop in Gludin Village.

steps.title: 2: Recovery of the Stolen Cargo
steps.text: This quest involves recovering a cargo of sword molds stolen by Turek Orcs. Recover 20 of them and take them to the Dark Elven trader named Tyra. She can be found in the west, near the Altar of Rites. Monsters to hunt: Turek Orc Footmen, Turek Orc Suppliers, Turek Orc Skirmishers, and Turek Orc Archers.

steps.title: 3: Tyra's Bill
steps.text: You have recovered the stolen cargo and delivered it to Tyra. Take the letter she gave to Trader Arodin in Gludin Village.

steps.title: 4: Arodin's request has been fulfilled.
steps.text: You have fulfilled Trader Arodin's request. Now report back to Guard Alvah.

steps.title: 5: Find the missing patrolman!
steps.text: A patrolman assigned to conduct surveillance on the ol mahums has gone missing. He was last seen by Guard Alvah, hiding from pursuing ol mahums in the Ruins of Agony. You are asked to investigate. Begin by confronting the tumran bugbears that are found there.

steps.title: 6: Proof Regarding Suspicious Activities
steps.text: It is becoming obvious that the ol mahums and Dwarven traders have formed an alliance. Until definite proof is found of this, however, it cannot be brought before the Dwarven guild. Go and get evidence of this unholy alliance from the ol mahum generals in the Abandoned Camp.

steps.title: 7: Who's Pulling the Strings?
steps.text: The document you secured from the ol mahums must be evidence of their agreement with the Dwarves. You must determine the true identity of the Dwarf who signed this paper. Neti in Gludin Village may have some information for you.

steps.title: 8: Identity of the Betrayer
steps.text: Now we know that the Dwarven trader Rolento was the one who signed the weapons trade agreement with the ol mahums. Go and find him at the south entrance of the Wastelands.

steps.title: 9: Information about the Invasion Plan
steps.text: Rolento explains that if you will deliver some cargo to the Turek Orcs on his behalf, you may be able to obtain their invasion plans. Take the cargo and the Dwarven guild mark to Turek Chief Burai in the Orc barracks.

steps.title: 10: Punishment of Ol Mahums
steps.text: Turek Chief Burai is enraged to learn of the ol mahums' deception. He offers to cancel the invasion of Gludin Village if you will join him and his forces in the destruction of the ol mahums. Kill 30 ol mahum captains and take their heads to Turek Chief Burai.

steps.title: 11: Fight between Orcs and Ol Mahums
steps.text: The Orc invasion of Gludin Village has been averted. Report to Guard Alvah.

quests.name: An Elder Sows Seeds
quests.description: The forbidden spellbook, used to protect against the devil Beleth, immediately transformed the once-fertile land south of Aden into a barren wasteland. Now, at last, Elder Casian has hopes of rekindling life there.

steps.title: 1: Find Kranvel's Spellbook
steps.text: Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook has been opened for the upcoming fight with Beleth. The magic power emanating from the book has destroyed fertile farmland and produced weird and grotesque creatures. Filled with rage and grief, Spellsinger Diena destroyed the magus's spellbook. Rumor says it is now located in the Ant Nest. Elder Casian wishes to open Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook again. Obtain the Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook so he can recultivate the Wastelands. Kill Ant Recruits, Ant Patrols, Ant Guards, Noble Ants and Noble Ant Leaders.

quests.name: I'd Rather Be Collecting Fairy Breath
quests.description: Collect the breath of Wind Sylph, the wind fairy, on Windy Hill.

steps.title: 1: Collecting Fairy Breath
steps.text: The Head Summoner Galatea asks to defeat the mad wind fairies on Windy Hill and collecting the last sighs of the fairies. Monsters to Hunt: Sobbing Wind, Babbling Wind, Giggling Wind.

quests.name: Aiding the Floran Village
quests.description: The Floran Village is a farmers' commune. The village has been growing, but needs some extra help these days.

steps.title: 1: The Woes of Floran Village
steps.text: Floran Village needs help in their fight against their oppressive lord. Meet with Captain Alex in Floran Village.

steps.title: 2: Eliminate the Monsters in Floran Clearing
steps.text: Defeat the monsters in the Floran Clearing and take evidence of your success to Captain Alex. Monsters to Hunt: Watchman of the Plains, Cursed Seer, Roughly Hewn Rock Golem, Delu Lizardmen Supplier, Delu Lizardmen Special Agent, Delu Lizardmen Commander, Shaman of the Delu Lizardmen

quests.name: Arrow of Vengeance
quests.description: The land dragon Antharas has been ravaging the kingdom of Aden for the past several years. There is one person in particular who seeks to avenge his tyranny...

steps.title: 1: Death Arrow
steps.text: Guard Belton asks you to help him collect the ingredients. Hunt in the Gorgon Flower Garden - Harpy, Medusa, Wyrm

quests.name: Curiosity of a Dwarf
quests.description: Dwarves are naturally curious, but Rolento is even more curious than most! He's looking for some like-minded individuals to join him...

steps.title: 1: Golem's Stoneheart
steps.text: Dwarven Trader Rolento asks you to obtain a piece of stone that is known as 'Heart Stone.' Hunt in the Wastelands - Punchers and Granite Golems.

quests.name: Gather Ingredients for Pie
quests.description: To make a special pie for this weekend's banquet, help Emily collect honey from bees.

steps.title: 1: Collecting Honey Pouches
steps.text: Mrs. Emily wants to bake a pie for the tea party at the temple this weekend. Collect honey from wasps in the Beehive area. Monsters to Hunt: Wasp Leaders, Wasp Workers

steps.title: 2: Collection of Honey Pouches Completed
steps.text: After much hard work, you've collected pouches of honey. Deliver them to Mrs. Emily.

quests.name: Leto Lizardmen Hunting
quests.description: Defeat the Leto Lizardmen that have increased suddenly!

steps.title: 1: Hunt Leto Lizardman
steps.text: Destroy all Leto Lizardmen in the Plains of the Lizardmen except their Shamans to avoid interrupting the strange ritual. Monsters to be hunted: Leto Lizardmen, Leto Lizardman Archers, Leto Lizardman Soldiers, Leto Lizardman Chiefs and Leto Lizardman Warriors.

steps.title: 2: Collection of Lizardmen's Bracelets Completed
steps.text: You've collected all the evidence that you hunted Leto Lizardmen. Hurry up and take them to Guard Rath.

quests.name: Black Swan
quests.description: Tasaba lizardmen have stolen cargo belonging to Iason Heine, owner of the the most successful commercial guild in Heine! Kill the lizardmen and recover the cargo!

steps.title: 1: Subjugation of Tasaba Lizardmen
steps.text: Captain Gosta of Heine asks you to bring back lizardmen fangs or the barrels of league that were stolen and Iason Heine will give you a reward. Hunt in the Field of Silence - Tasaba Lizardmen and Tasaba Lizardmen Shamans.

steps.title: 2: Iason Heine's Reward
steps.text: The cargo belonging to the Commercial Guild of Iason Heine has been stolen by Tasaba lizardmen. You are hunting them. Bring back their fangs and Iason Heine will give you a reward. Recover the barrels of league that were stolen and he will give you some bills of Iason Heine worth 700 adena each. If you take them to Head Blacksmith Roman in Heine he will exchange them for items.

quests.name: Method to Raise the Dead
quests.description: After many hardships, Locksmith Dorothy and her friends succeeded in stealing the treasure of the legendary pirate, Zaken! The shining fang awaited them near the village.

steps.title: 1: Collecting Victim's Bones
steps.text: Locksmith Dorothy asks you to determine what happened to her recently vanished friends. She fears that they were eaten by Crokians on the Field of Whispers and wants you to search there for their bones. Hunt Crokians and Crokian Warriors.

steps.title: 2: In Search of a Dark Elf
steps.text: You find Dorothy's friends' bones but no other clues. Dorothy tells you a rumor of a clay jar, in the possession of the Dark Elf Guild, that supposedly has the power to raise the dead.

steps.title: 3: Medium's Jar
steps.text: Magister Xenovia sells you the magic powder needed to summon dead souls with the clay jar.

steps.title: 4: What Dorothy Wanted
steps.text: You have spoken with the spirit of the victim through the medium's jar.

steps.title: 5: Who is this?
steps.text: The spirit in the medium's jar was no friend of Dorothy.

quests.name: Little Wing
quests.description: Hatchlings are, quite honestly, ugly little creatures! But how else are you to get a strider and wyvern?

steps.title: 1: Elder Cronos
steps.text: Quest that must be completed in order to obtain a pet hatchling. Visit Pet Manager Cooper and tell him that you wish to raise a hatchling. He will tell you to seek help from Elder Cronos of Hunters Village.

steps.title: 2: Make a Fairy Stone
steps.text: After collecting the items requested by Elder Cronos, find Maria in the Town of Dion and ask her to make a Fairy Stone for you. Take the Fairy Stone to Cronos and he'll tell you what you need to do next.

steps.title: 3: Fairy's Existence
steps.text: Take the completed Elven stone to Guard Byron and ask him about fairies.

steps.title: 4: In Search of a Fairy
steps.text: Go to Fairy Valley and find a fairy who will talk with you.

steps.title: 5: In Search of a Dragon Species
steps.text: Take the juice of monkshood that Fairy Mimyu gave you to the drake or wyrm that she introduced you to.

steps.title: 6: Find the Stolen Eggs

quests.name: Treasure Hunt
quests.description: The legendary Pirate Captain Zaken left many legends and even more bodies in his wake! One story tells of his treasure, and it seems to be the one most people want to hear. Trader Espen can tell you more!

steps.title: 1: Decipher the Pirate's Treasure Map!
steps.text: Ask Trader Espen of Heine to decipher the pirate's treasure map for you.

steps.title: 2: Find the Pirate's Treasure Chest!
steps.text: The pirate's treasure map has disclosed the location of the hidden treasure chest! Go to the place marked on the map. Don't forget to buy the Thief Key from the grocery store.

quests.name: Dig Up the Sea of Spores!
quests.description: The Wizards of the Ivory Tower have sought to stem the spread of the Sea of Spores since ancient times. Now they want a permanent solution to this problem.

steps.title: 1: Collect Spores
steps.text: Magister Gauen asks that you bring him Carnivore Spores and Herbivorous Spores. Hunt to the Sea of Spores - Rotting Trees and Spore Zombies.

steps.title: 2: Continue collecting? Or will you return?
steps.text: You've filled a spore sac. Do you wish to fill the other sac or do you wish to return to Magister Gauen at the Ivory Tower? Hunt Rotting Trees and Spore Zombies.

steps.title: 3: Return to Gauen
steps.text: You've filled up both of the spore sacs. Return to Magister Gauen at the Ivory Tower.

quests.name: An Obvious Lie
quests.description: High Priest Maximilian asked Gentler to make him some medicine, but the process was interrupted and has been delayed. He asks you to help Gentler.

steps.title: 1: Meet Gentler
steps.text: High Priest Maximilian says that Trader Gentler of Giran Castle Town needs help. Go meet Gentler.

steps.title: 2: Find Miki the Cat
steps.text: Trader Gentler says that he's lost contact with Miki the Cat on Devil's Isle and asks you to deliver the map to him and get some herbs in return.

steps.title: 3: Find Herbs
steps.text: Miki the Cat says that he found the herbs, but lost them when the pouch containing the herbs got torn while he was wandering around lost. He asks you to obtain 20 herbs. Get them by hunting alligators on Alligator Beach. Monster to Hunt - Alligators

steps.title: 4: Deliver the Herbs
steps.text: You've got all the herbs that Trader Gentler of Giran Castle Town asked for. Take them to him immediately!

steps.title: 5: Collect Spirit Ore
steps.text: Gentler needs 500 more Spirit Ores to make the medicine and asks you to get them.

steps.title: 6: Get Your Reward
steps.text: You ask Trader Gentler to pay you and he says that Miki the Cat has already been paid for the runestones. He tells you to get the money from him.

steps.title: 7: A Lie Exposed
steps.text: Miki the Cat says he never signed any contract and sends you back to Trader Gentler in Giran Castle Town.

steps.title: 8: The Final Ingredient
steps.text: Gentler apologizes and promises to make you an exquisite accessory if you'll bring him some more ingredients. He asks you to collect 1,000 thread and 500 suede.

quests.name: Warehouse Keeper's Ambition
quests.description: Warehouse Chief Baxt recently announced retirement, and the competition to replace him has already grown fierce among the freightmen.

steps.title: 1: Collect Jade Crystals
steps.text: Warehouse Freightman Silva asks that you collect Jade Crystals for her. She offers an extra reward if you bring her 200 or more Jade Crystals at a time. Hunt in the Enchanted Valley - Fline, Liele, Valley Treant, Satyr, Unicorn, Forest Runner, Fline Elder, Liele Elder, Valley Treant Elder, Satyr Elder, Unicorn Elder, Spirit of Timiniel, Timiniels Spirit Guard.

quests.name: Lu4: Quest Coins of Magic 40+
quests.description: Repeatable | Location: Hunter's Village

steps.title: Step 1
steps.text:
The Quest Chain Coins of Magic is one of the main quests for obtaining C-grade Armor, Jewelry and Weapon Parts. The Lu4 team has reworked the quest chain and rewards while maintaining the overall concept.

The quest involves hunting monsters and collecting Magic Coins, which can be exchanged for Equipment at an NPC.

Lu4 introduces important changes to a quest familiar to many players. Features of the quest on Lu4:

In the subsequent quests of the chain, you can obtain B-grade weapon recipes. To purchase them, you will need Magic Coins, which can only be obtained in this quest.

Join the Coin Collectors and collect Magic Coins!

quests.description: Devil's Isle is home to the restless spirits of Pirate Captain Zaken and his men. That island holds some ghastly secrets...

Go to Devil's Isle and slay Sairon, her doll and puppet, and then take some of her silver hair to Magister Dieter.

quests.name: An Aged Ex-Adventurer
quests.description: The aged ex-adventurer left home for some excitement and found serious trouble. If you encounter him during the adventure, help him out.

steps.title: 1: Did the Old Adventurer Return Home?
steps.text: During the adventure, you come across a former adventurer, all soulshots are run out at a dangerous hunting ground... and spare the soulshots to the old man with limited mobility. Let's go find out if the old man went back home safely by meeting his daughter-in-law Sarah at the grocery store in the town of Oren...

quests.name: Lu4: Quest Seductive Whispers 50+
quests.description: Repeatable

quests.name: Power of Darkness
quests.description: Galman spends his time alone in Dragon Valley... Nobody wants to go near him, but he has a story to tell...

steps.title: 1: Power of Darkness
steps.text: Galman asks you to find him a Stone of Contract. Hunt in the Dragon Valley - Malruk Succubus, Malruk Succubus Turens.

quests.name: Whisper of Dreams, Part 1
quests.description: A dark chaos is about to descend upon the world! Seer Manakia received a warning in a dream, and is planning a ceremony to try and better understand the coming darkness...

steps.title: 1: Onto Antharas' Lair
steps.text: Seer Manakia asks you to obtain the items he needs. Hunt to Antharas' Lair: Cave Beasts and Death Waves.

steps.title: 2: Mysterious Stone
steps.text: Take the sealed mysterious stone to Dwarf Torai near the entrance to Dragon Valley.

steps.title: 3: Onto Antharas' Lair
steps.text: Show the mysterious stone to Seer Manakia. If you wish to help him, obtain the molars of cave beasts and flames of death wave he needs for the ritual.

quests.name: Make a Pair of Dress Shoes
quests.description: While making formal wear, Leikar asks you to go to Trader Woodley get some dress shoes. Woodley doesn't make them, however.

steps.title: 1: Meet Leikar
steps.text: Woodley asks you to meet Leikar and get the materials for the formal wear she's making. Find Leikar and get some fabric.

steps.title: 2: Meet Woodley
steps.text: Leikar doesn't have any more of the formal wear fabric, but she's willing to make some for Woodley if you tell him it's the one that she made long ago.

steps.title: 3: Gather Ingredients
steps.text: Woodley needs materials to make the dress shoes and asks you to bring him 200 leather, 600 thread and 500,000 adena.

steps.title: 4: Woodley's Errands
steps.text: Woodley asks you to deliver 300,000 adena to Ian to pay off the balance on his account while he's making the dress shoes. Trader Ian located in Ivory Tower.

steps.title: 5: Meet Woodley
steps.text: Ian accepts the payment and asks you to tell Woodley that he will charge interest next time.

quests.name: In Search of Cloth
quests.description: Radia says that the ingredients she needs haven't arrived yet. She asks you to go to the Town of Gludio and check on her delivery.

steps.title: 1: Go to Varan
steps.text: Radia hasn't begun work because the ingredients that she ordered haven't been delivered yet. Visit Trader Varan and check on her delivery.

steps.title: 2: Return to Radia
steps.text: Varan says it is difficult to get the supply and he cannot deliver the order on the due date and asks for understanding.

steps.title: 3: Go to Ralford
steps.text: Radia says she'll contact Ralford in the Ivory Tower in advance and asks you to get the materials from her.

steps.title: 4: Squash the Spiders
steps.text: Ralford doesn't have the items that Radia ordered, but she could get the spidersilk if she had some spinnerets. Go to the Sea of Spores and get 10 spinnerets. Monsters to Hunt - Trisalim Spiders, Trisalim Tarantulas

steps.title: 5: Go to Ralford
steps.text: You've hunted Trisalims and Trisalim Tarantulas and obtained 10 spinnerets. Return to Ralford and ask her to spin out the spidersilk.

steps.title: 6: Return to Radia
steps.text: Ralford makes you the spidersilk and asks you to bring him 3,000 units of suede and 5,000 thread.

quests.name: Find Glittering Jewelry
quests.description: Leikar asks you to go to Ellie and get the gem from her, but Ellie says that she didn't finish because her delivery didn't arrive.

steps.title: 1: Go to Felton
steps.text: Ellie says the ore that she ordered haven't arrived and asks you to visit Felton and find out when her order will arrive.

steps.title: 2: Sail for Alligator Beach
steps.text: Felton suggests you go to Alligator Beach to get the ore by hunting Alligators. Bring back 10 ore.

steps.title: 3: Return to Ellie
steps.text: You've got 10 ore. Return to Ellie and ask her to make them into gems.

steps.title: 4: Ingredients to Cut Gems
steps.text: Ellie says she needs more materials and asks you to bring her 5 oriharukon, 500 units of silver and 150 thons.

quests.name: Make a Sewing Kit
quests.description: Leikar asks you to visit Ferris in Aden Castle Town and make a sewing kit. You'll need an extraordinary ingredient to make it.

steps.title: 1: Get Reinforced Steel
steps.text: Ferris needs enchanted iron and asks you to catch an Enchanted Iron Golem in the Ivory Tower and bring him 5 fragments of the golem. Monster to Hunt - Enchanted Iron Golem

steps.title: 2: Return to Ferris
steps.text: You've attained 5 fragments from the Enchanted Iron Golem. Return to Ferris.

steps.title: 3: Gather Ingredients
steps.text: Ferris asks for 10 artisan's frames and 10 oriharukon to make a sewing kit.

quests.name: Make Formal Wear
quests.description: You visited Alexis to have some formal wear made, but learned that her maid, Leikar, makes it better than she does. Go and see Leikar.

steps.title: 1: Finding Leikar
steps.text: Trader Alexis says Leikar makes great formal wear and tells you to visit her.

steps.title: 2: Leikar's Request
steps.text: Leikar asks you to run errands for her while she's making the formal wear. Visit Jeremy and get some cookies.

steps.title: 3: Jeremy's Errands
steps.text: Jeremy asks you to deliver wine to Mist while he's baking cookies.

steps.title: 4: Return to Jeremy
steps.text: You've delivered the wine to Mist. Return to Jeremy and get the cookies.

steps.title: 5: Leikar's Errands
steps.text: Jeremy made you the cookies that Leikar asked for. Carefully deliver them.

steps.title: 6: Leikar's Request
steps.text: Leikar says she ordered the materials for the formal wear, but they've not yet been delivered and she asks you to check on them. Ask Blacksmith Ferris in Aden Castle Town about the sewing kit, Radia in Giran Castle Town about the fabrics, Ellie in Giran Castle Town about the gems.

steps.title: 7: Making Shoes
steps.text: Leikar asks you to go to Trader Woodley in Aden Castle Town and have the dress shoes made while she's making the formal wear.

quests.name: Lu4: Quest Song of Hunter 30+
quests.description: Repeatable | Location: Hunter's Village

steps.title: Step 1
steps.text:
The quest "Song of the Hunter" is a multi-stage repeatable quest with valuable rewards. The Lu4 developers have reworked the quest and its rewards while preserving its overall concept.

The quest includes several different activities, such as:

Increasing your Hunter’s Guild membership rank improves the list of available activities.

quests.name: Whisper of Dreams, Part 2
quests.description: Seer Manakia is not able to adequately foresee the coming darkness. He asks for help in acquiring better materials.

steps.title: 1: Deepest part of Antharas' Lair
steps.text: Seer Manakia asks you to obtain the items he needs. Hunt to Antharas' Lair: Cave Howlers and Kariks.

quests.name: Relics of the Fallen
quests.description: Priest Ross asks you to travel to the Field of Massacre, lay the dead to rest, and collect their belongings for a purification ritual. In return, he will reward you with valuables stored in the temple warehouses.

steps.title: 1: Repose of the Dead
steps.text: Priest Ross asks you to go to the Field of Massacre and destroy monsters in order to collect Fallen Warrior’s Insignia and Fallen Knight’s Token for a prayer for the repose of the souls of fallen heroes. If you encounter Einhasad's Altar of Mercy, you can offer the prayer yourself. Monsters to be hunted - Grave Lich, Dismal Pole, Doom Scout, Doom Trooper, Doom Warrior, Doom Archer, Doom Guard, Doom Servant, Doom Knight, Spiteful Soul Leader, Spiteful Soul Wizard, Spiteful Soul Fighter.

quests.name: The Sealed Archives, part 1
quests.description: Lara of the Bronze Key Guild is rescuing ancient books looted from the Tower of Insolence's archives. She's currently seeking volunteers to help.

steps.title: 1: Sealed Tome of Lower Archive
steps.text: Blueprint Seller Lara asks you to find Sealed Tomes of the Lower Archive for her. They can be found while hunting all monsters on floors 2 - 7 of the Tower of Insolence.

steps.title: 2: Conversation with Lara
steps.text: Show Blueprint Seller Lara your findings.

steps.title: 3: Kill Korim!
steps.text: Kill Korim on the 6th floor of the Tower of Insolence and find out what happened to the sealed upper archive.

steps.title: 4: Conversation with Lara
steps.text: Tell Blueprint Seller Lara the results of the investigation.

steps.title: 5: Sealed Tome of Lower Archive
steps.text: Blueprint Seller Lara asks you to find Sealed Tomes of the Lower Archive for her. They can be found while hunting all monsters on floors 2 - 7 of the Tower of Insolence.

quests.name: Finds from the Giant’s Cave
quests.description: According to Sobling, traces of ancient giant workshops still remain in the lower halls of the Giant’s Cave. Among the creatures dwelling there, sealed papyri can sometimes be found containing fragments of production records: armor schematics, weapon forging notes, and remnants of ruined prototypes.

steps.title: 1: Search for the Damaged Papyrus of Giants
steps.text: Explorer Sobling asks you to explore the Cave of Giants in search of the Damaged Papyrus of Giants. Monsters to be hunted - Giant Stonebreaker, Giant Huntsman, Giant Runecaster, Giant Warden, Giant Remnant, Giant Overseer, Barif.

steps.title: 2: Search for the Sealed Papyrus of Giants
steps.text: Explorer Sobling asks you to explore the Cave of Giants in search of the Sealed Papyrus of Giants. Monsters to be hunted - Giant Stonebreaker, Giant Huntsman, Giant Runecaster, Giant Warden, Giant Remnant, Giant Overseer, Barif.

quests.name: The Ember Crucible
quests.description: Have you heard of the Blazing Swamp? Legend says this place was created by Pa'agrio himself... In the heat of its lava, metals turn into enchanted alloys that cannot be reproduced in an ordinary forge. Even the monsters that inhabit it possess special properties. Prefect Marestella is passionate about crafting jewelry and is currently in need of materials to create a new high-quality set.

steps.title: 1: High-quality materials
steps.text: Prefect Marestella asks you to explore the Blazing Swamp in search of high-quality and unusual materials. If you can get a Prismatic Flame Core, try to craft Stabilized Magical Metal in the Ember Crucible. Monsters to be hunted - Tulben, Conjurer Bat Lord, Conjurer Bat, Lava Wyrm, Hames Orc Scout, Hames Orc Footman, Hames Orc Sniper, Hames Orc Shaman, Hames Orc Overlord, Cindermire Golem, Cindereye Basilisk, Slagbound Colossus, Emberspine Lavasaur, Cinderveil Reanimator, Cindermire Warden.

quests.name: Banners of the Ancient Battleground
quests.description: Magister Desmond is studying the unusual behavior of monsters on the Ancient Battlefield. He believes necromancy is the cause, but he can't find any proof. He's currently seeking a volunteer to help him confirm his theory.

steps.title: 1: Rusty Insignia
steps.text: Magister Desmond asks you to find any insignia on the Ancient Battlefield. Monsters to be hunted - Corpse Gnawer, Bone Stalker, Battlefield Ghoul, Battlefield Abomination.

steps.title: 2: Return to Desmond
steps.text: Bring the Rusty Insignia to Magister Desmond

steps.title: 3: Search for military artifacts
steps.text: Search the Ancient Battleground for military artifacts; they are highly valued by Magister Desmond. Monsters to be hunted - Corpse Gnawer, Battleworn Dead, Bone Stalker, Fallen Duelist, Mourning Banshee, Grave Warlock, Battlefield Ghoul, Battlefield Abomination, Fallen Shieldbearer, Fallen Halberdier, Grave Witch, High Necromancer.

quests.name: The Sealed Archives, part 2
quests.description: It was recently discovered that the seal to the Tower of Insolence's upper archives had been broken and the archive itself looted. Lara is searching for brave adventurers willing to risk their lives to rescue the priceless books.

steps.title: 1: Sealed Tome of Upper Archive
steps.text: Blueprint Seller Lara asks you to find Sealed Tomes of the Upper Archive for her. They can be found while hunting all monsters on floors 8 - 13 of the Tower of Insolence.
